1. OKC Regional Account (Drop & Hook + Spot Backhaul)
We operate a dedicated account out of Oklahoma City hauling palletized home goods.
This is an excellent fit for drivers based in OKC or North Texas.
● Pick up a preloaded trailer in OKC (drop & hook)
● Deliver to a Midwest location (live unload, location varies)
● After delivery, we secure a backhaul (live load) from the spot market
● That load delivers back toward the OKC area (live unload)
● Return to OKC, drop the trailer, hook another one, and repeat
This is a consistent regional loop, and drivers assigned here are hired specifically for this

"I have a great opportunity with Yankee Freight for experienced CDL drivers. They are paying between 65 and 75 CPM depending on your experience, driving record, and the truck you choose. All miles are paid, including loaded and empty miles, and payment is every Friday.
